comment: One rule: METATILE_<Tileset>_<Label> constants are copied from the donor ONLY when the tileset's metatiles.bin is byte-identical on both sides — because the constant is an index into that file, so a verbatim copy is correct exactly when the thing it indexes matches. Try editing target/tiles/sec/town/metatiles.bin and re-running the demo: the rule then refuses to resolve.
